_comment: design-sync converter tsconfig — read ONLY by the esbuild tsconfigPathsPlugin (compilerOptions.paths + baseUrl). baseUrl '..' resolves to repo root since this file is in .design-sync/. The two explicit non-wild dir-barrel rules come BEFORE @/* so the plugin's rule loop resolves them to index.ts (a file) instead of returning a bare directory (which esbuild rejects). next/link is shimmed so Next's client runtime never enters the IIFE bundle (it referenced process.env.__NEXT_* and aborted window.WetInk).
